{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
cleaned_revenue = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = cleaned_revenue == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders to exclude: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Also check: are there any refunded orders?
refunded_mask = sales['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {refunded_mask.sum()}')

# The question asks for completed orders from loyal customers
# So we need: customer_segment == 'loyal' AND status == 'completed'
loyal_mask = sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
completed_mask = sales['status'] == 'completed'

# Combine masks: loyal AND completed AND not QA
selection_mask = loyal_mask & completed_mask & ~qa_mask

# Filter the data
filtered_data = sales[selection_mask]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = filtered_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float).mean()

# Print result
print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {mean_revenue:.2f}')"}
